For input 101000, traverse the graph bit by bit: input 1 selects the dashed 00->10 branch and records 11; input 0 selects the solid 10->01 branch and records 01; input 1 selects the dashed 01->10 branch and records 00; input 0 selects the solid 10->01 branch and records 01; input 0 selects the solid 01->00 branch and records 11; input 0 selects the solid 00->00 loop and records 00. Concatenate these output pairs to obtain the 12-bit encoded sequence.
